observations: Three photos show multiple used car engines stored in a cluttered space, likely a workshop or scrapyard.
The engines appear dirty, dusty, and show signs of wear and tear.
Photo 0 shows a close-up of one engine with a black intake manifold, visible pulleys, and a yellow dipstick.
Photo 1 shows another engine from a different angle, with a visible crankshaft pulley and a yellow dipstick.
Photo 2 shows a wider view with multiple engines stacked or placed close together, including one with a black intake manifold similar to photo 0.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on any engine in any photo.
The watermark 'CHIDON AUTO' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are overlaid on all photos.
The seller claims 'Home of kia engine' and offers a 3-month guarantee on all engines and gearboxes.
